main.description: A directed link from one note to another ATProto record or external URL. Powers Zettelkasten backlinks and cross-lexicon connections. One record per link direction — the AppView computes the reverse for backlinks.

source.description: AT-URI of the social.crate.note that contains this link.

target.description: Link destination. Exactly one of atUri or externalUrl must be set. atUri is preferred for federated records (notes, books, episodes, talks). externalUrl is used for external web resources or unresolved [[wikilinks]].

atUri.description: AT-URI of the target record when the link resolves to an ATProto resource.

externalUrl.description: External URL when the target is outside the AT network (or the [[wikilink]] has not yet been resolved to a record).

title.description: Human-readable title of the link target, stored for display without requiring a round-trip.

description.description: Optional short description or excerpt of the link target.

context.description: The surrounding sentence, paragraph, or annotation that contains this link in the source note. Used for rich backlink previews.

anchorText.description: The visible link text or [[wikilink]] phrase as it appeared in the source note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this link record was created.
